verdicts.summary: Every failure the note lists is already in finding 0. Those are a lost or refused settle, a restart dropping the fiber, and a failure that is only logged. I found no other way to break this path.

The 24h wait in a forked fiber can end without settling. That happens on timeout, on a run that is not completed, on a wait failure, or when a bounded live-stream overflow (LiveStreamBudget.ts:95-96) fails the wait. In each case the outcome is silent, and finding 0 already states this, along with the duplicate fibers that hold streams for up to 24h.
